paper_metadata.title: Development of the interlayer alloy using for TLP diffusion bonding of GH3230 superalloy based on the CALPHAD method

evidence.section: Abstract

evidence.section: 4.1. GH3230 alloy TLP diffusion bonding process parameters and testing methods
evidence.quote: The KNi-5 interlayer was prepared into an amorphous foil strip using vacuum melting followed by rapid cooling under argon protection, with a thickness ranging from 0.025 to 0.035 mm and a melting temperature between 1054.80 and 1129.36 ◦C.
